title: NewWave (2021)
excerpt:
Completed while with Neuewave.
—


Built electronic components and programmed the installation's motion control system.
—
content:
Completed while with Neuewave.
—

Built the electronics and programmed the motion-control system for NewWave, a kinetic object by Neuewave about ocean waste, first shown as Sea of Debris at Archifest 2021.
—
